svg.title: Bank teller — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as bank teller, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A banknote and round coin sit above a service-counter line beside two short cash-stack edges. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a tapered face and round glasses.
